variants.headline: Party leader blunders in election debate
variants.body: The leader of {party}, {leader}, has blundered in an election debate. Give {target} a fair hearing; outrage alone should not be allowed to write the whole verdict.

variants.headline: A debate brings a leader's misstep
variants.body: An election debate has included a blunder by {leader}, leader of {party}. Give {target} a fair hearing; outrage alone should not be allowed to write the whole verdict.

variants.headline: Election argument meets an awkward moment
variants.body: The party leader {leader}, of {party}, has made a debate misstep. Give {target} a fair hearing; outrage alone should not be allowed to write the whole verdict.
